name: Frozen Bodies at 10 stacks guarantees a crit without a second 1.5x on Glacial Impact damage (#10025)
contract: Frozen Bodies712434 reads 'Increases the damage of your next Glacial Impact by $s1% for $d, stacking $u times. Reaching 10 stacks causes your next Glacial Impact to critically strike for 50% increased damage.' The crit is the 50% increased damage (spell crit multiplier), not a second multiplier: live Glacial Impact707592 hits at 10 stacks are about 1.031 times the 9-stack crit (14 pairs), all crit. The server forces a 100% crit chance at the DBC-defined StackAmount cap of 10 and leaves base damage alone (ADR 0563, reversing the x1.5 of #10025/#10573). The control cast is forced to crit the same way via spell_crit_rating, so the 10-stack cast must deal the control crit times the stack spellmod only (about 1.03), far from 1.5.

steps.label: Permafrost makes the unfrozen dummy a valid target
Precondition: no partial resists, so both crits are comparable
CONTROL: the control cast crits (forced by spell_crit_rating)
CONTRACT: the 10-stack crit deals the 9-stack crit plus the stack spellmod only (no extra 1.5x)
